title: Add the 17 Duris player races
description:
Implements the Duris player races plan (the plan itself is retired in the last commit; its content now lives in `docs/guides/PLAYER_RACES_REFERENCE.md`).

Closes #2

## What changes

- **Shared mechanics.** `FEAT_LEONINE_FRAME` becomes `FEAT_TAURIC_FRAME` (same ID 1267). New `FEAT_PSIONIC_RESISTANCE` (1322) held by Trelux; the mental-damage case and the Lich cold immunity read their feats beside the race checks saved characters still need. Race grants of epic damage reduction now build the DR entry through `update_feat_damage_reduction()`. `race_is_transformation_only()` is the single hard-lock predicate. `respec_engine()` accepts a NULL argument for every race.
- **Twelve creation races (IDs 152-163):** Centaur, Githzerai, Firbolg, Githyanki, Kobold, Drider, Thri-Kreen, Minotaur, Kuo Toa, Orog, Harpy, Stormkin. Registry data, parser (name and display name), creation help cases, web media keys, XP tiers, hit points, family predicates, lost slots.
- **Five descend forms (IDs 55-59):** Death Knight, Wight, Revenant, Shadow Beast, Phantom. Transformation-only; a standard quest race reward converts through `descend_form_conversions[]` in `src/quest/quest.c`. QEDIT, `wtool`, and `QUEST_FILE_FORMAT.md` accept the IDs. No quest awards a form yet.
- **Help:** `sql/components/help_duris_races_entries.sql` (+ verifier, manifest, `EXTRA_DIST`), PSIONIC-RESISTANCE topic, Thri-Kreen in EPIC-RACES; `help.hlp` is the exact projection of the development help DB.
- **Docs:** race reference, race guide, mechanics reference, limb mechanics.

## Worth a reviewer's attention

These go beyond the plan, each because this work exposed the defect:

- An epic damage reduction DR entry has spell 0, which the player-file DR save skips as a duplicate, so it was never saved (study-taken DR was lost on every reload). `load_char()` now rebuilds it from the feat's real ranks.
- `process_race_level_feats()` read `GET_RACE()` (the disguise race). It now reads `GET_REAL_RACE()`, since these are the first races with grants above level 1.
- Protocol v1 web onboarding lists every race on one page; with 45 races it overflowed the 15000-byte payload. v1 race summaries are now 140 characters (`WEB_ONBOARDING_V1_RACE_SUMMARY_CHARS`); v2 is unchanged.
- The Minotaur help topic updates the retired Dragonlance `minotaur` entry in place (it already owned the MINOTAUR and RACE-MINOTAUR keywords), so nothing is deleted.

## Verification

- `make test`: 1836 CuTest cases pass; the full local CI matrix (33 jobs) passes on the head, 6446f4af8; `scripts/world/tests/test_semantics.py` passes.
- New tests: `TestDurisCreationRaces*`, `TestDescendForm*`, `TestRaceLevelFeatsFollowTheRealRace`, `TestRaceGrantedDamageReductionBuildsOneEntryThatSurvivesReload`, `TestRespecEngineAcceptsANullArgument` (`test_race_equivalence.c`); psionic resistance, cold immunity, tauric frame (`test_racial_innate_feats.c`); media keys and a fully unlocked plus forged-form catalog (`test_web_onboarding.c`).
- Help SQL applied twice to shadow tables with the verifier passing; the development help DB projects exactly to the committed `help.hlp`.
- Live check on port 4100: bought and created a Thri-Kreen through the terminal, bought a Centaur and created it through the web catalog's `wireValue`, created a premade Kobold, leveled the Thri-Kreen through its level 6 and 11 grants, and reconnected all three. The forms stay out of both catalogs and `accexp`.

## After merge

- Production help needs the help-sync run; nothing here touches production.
- Each descend form still needs its quest (modeled on the Vampire line, quest 34721, zone 347) before anyone can become one.

## Review fixes (6446f4af8)

- Every race reward now saves once the quest history and next stage are recorded, before a follower's load trigger can run, so a restart cannot reopen a completed conversion quest. The Lich and Vampire rewards had no final save at all.
- Transformation is one-way everywhere: the race-reward preflight, the legacy Lich quest (`hlquest.c`), and the Lich rite refuse a character whose real race is already transformation-only.

## Crash fix found during the live check

`close_socket()` freed the character of any descriptor outside `IS_PLAYING()`. The first-quit "Reason:" survey (`CON_QUIT_REASON`), mail and board composition, and the house and board editors keep a character that is still in the world in such states, so a dropped link there freed a character still on `character_list`: the server then spun at 100% CPU or segfaulted in `perform_dupe_check()` at the next login. A character still on the list now goes linkdead and saves; logging back in reconnects to it. Regression test: `Test_lost_link_at_the_quit_survey_leaves_the_character_linkdead` (it aborts on the old code). Verified live on port 4100: a new account's first quit, link dropped at "Reason:", then a login that reconnects with the server idle.

title: Replace the four-arm flag with an arm count
description:
Implements `docs/ongoing-projects/ARM_COUNT_PLAN.md`: one arm count replaces the three separate extra-limb mechanics. Equipment stays capped at four arms. The plan is retired, and `EXTRA_LIMB_MECHANICS.md` is now the record of the implemented system.

## What changes

- **`arm_count()`** (`src/core/utils.c`) replaces `has_four_arms()`. It starts at 2, adds a PC race's new signed `race_data.arm_adjust` (0 for every race, so no race changes; NPCs start at 2 because their `GET_RACE()` is a family ID), +2 for Four Arms and +1 per Extra Arms rank. `APPLY_FEAT` gear counts only from positions the intrinsic arms already open. Four Arms counts once across all sources. `hands_have()` is the count plus the vestigial arm, and is now exported.
- **`wear_slot_arms_needed()`** replaces `is_four_arm_wear_slot()`: 1/2/3/4-arm positions per the plan table. Counts from 0 up close or open positions for NPCs too; race anatomy still applies.
- **Wear command**: the pickers and the sleeve/glove/wrist overflow use only open positions, and full sets report correctly at 1 and 3 arms (no more "YOU SHOULD NEVER SEE THIS"). A launcher's second hand is charged, and two-hand items go to their pair's two-hand position. From three arms up, pair exclusivity is enforced in `equip_char()` too.
- **Lifecycle**: `limb_reconcile()` / `limb_defer_*()` / `limb_restore_validate()`. Closed positions empty in order, and the count is re-read after each displacement (cascading provider loss). A third arm splits a mixed first pair. Hand loss (6→5, a lost vestigial arm) trims held items first. Restore defers any closed position and validates the final hand budget. `save_char()` retries postponed positions once.
- **Combat**: Extra Arms no longer adds full-BAB swings. The second pair attacks from 3 arms, and the fourth hand needs 4. A `MONK_TYPE()` character passing `monk_gear_ok()` strikes unarmed with an empty third hand, using monk dice. An unarmed strike uses a hand for the third hand's spare-hand strength bonus.
- **Round plan**: `draw_attack_round_plan()` draws the extra flurry, Air Embodiment and Wilderness Warrior off-hand procs once per round. `perform_violence()` clears it at phase 1. Phases 2 and 3 replay it, along with phase 1's second-pair candidate list (`plan_second_pair()`) and numbering, so no attack changes phase within a round. A candidate the character no longer has (haste ended, weapon removed) keeps its ordinal and does not swing, and none is added mid-round.
- **Consumers**: one-hander bonus doubling needs an actual spare hand. A lone third-hand one-hander doubles only with a hand left after the primary's share (`second_pair_spare_hands()`), which the third hand's strength bonus also reads. `unsheath` draws each item only into an open, empty position with free hands. Anything else stays sheathed, and a later `unsheath` can draw it.
- **Docs and help**: the mechanics, save, race point and Duris docs, both feats' text, and EXTRA-ARMS / FOUR-ARMS in `help.hlp`, the SQL seed and the dev help DB (all three verified identical).

## Intentional behavior changes

- Extra Arms means one arm per rank instead of one swing per rank (no race grants it; check saved characters and staff items before deploying).
- Monks with 3+ arms get an unarmed third hand.
- A bow in `WIELD_1` beside a held item is now refused, because it needs two hands.
- One-armed and over-budget first-pair one-handers no longer double item bonuses.
- The extra flurry, Air Embodiment and Wilderness Warrior off-hand procs roll once per round, as their perk docs say, instead of once per phase call. The Air Embodiment message appears once per round.
- A three-armed unarmed third hand keeps plain STR (no +2): the primary's strike and support hand and its own strike use all three hands.
- A third-hand one-hander beside a first-pair one-hander doubles its item bonuses only when a hand is left after the primary's support hand (four hands, for example four arms).
- `unsheath` no longer refuses when a first-pair hand is occupied. It draws what fits and leaves the rest sheathed for a later `unsheath`.

## Open (not decided here)

The Extra Arms race point price (3 RP was set for the old swing) and the value the monk third hand adds to Four Arms are recorded as open balance work in `EXTRA_LIMB_MECHANICS.md`. No price was changed.

## Verification

- `make -j16 test`: 1819 tests OK, including 20 new `TestArmCount*` cases in `test_four_arms.c`. They cover sources, positions at 0 to 6 arms, low-count and six-arm commands, loss cascades, flat-file restore, repeated real `save_char()`, spare-hand doubling for both pairs, unsheath and resuming a partial draw, attack routines, failed mirror rolls, the round plan across haste and weapon changes, monk real hits, display dice and gloves. `make install` leaves no root binary.
- Mutation checks: each of these changes fails its test:
  - disabling the monk candidate, the `equip_char()` pair rule, the save retry, restore validation, spare-hand doubling, the closed-position trim, unsheath checks, provider eligibility or the unarmed-strike hand;
  - breaking the round plan: redraw per phase, no stored first ordinal, no phase-1 reset, live candidate lists, or no readiness or haste recheck;
  - restoring the third hand's `hands_have() > hands_used()` doubling or the blanket unsheath refusal.
- Local CI (`scripts/ci/local/run.py`, full matrix on cac8295f6): 33/33 jobs passed.
- `check_build_parity.py` OK; `wtool.py constants sync --check` current.
